negative_control.description: In a separate interpreter, pytest.MonkeyPatch replaces only AllocationService.release_adk_tool_caches with a no-op. Repository/SDK files are untouched and no test-side cache is cleared.
negative_control.command:
cd runtime && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:tests .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import pytest
import contractor_runtime.allocation.service as allocation_service
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
    patch.setattr(allocation_service, 'release_adk_tool_caches', lambda: None)
    result = pytest.main(['-q', '--tb=line', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-W', 'error', 'tests/test_agent_skill_lifecycle.py', '-k', 'used_skill_graph or failed_prepare_after_skill'])
raise SystemExit(result)
PY
negative_control.interpretation: Hashable proxies/metrics/tools remain reachable without production eviction. All three unhashable cases still pass because their static call methods and per-instance declaration paths retain no released allocation.
negative_control.plugin_note: Plugin autoload is disabled only for this control, avoiding unrelated anyio rewrite warnings from preloading the mutation. Normal gates retain -W error and ordinary plugin loading.
